title: Isotonic Conformal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2607.16675v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A predictor with small overall bias can still exhibit systematic bias conditional on its predicted value, limiting its reliability for downstream uncertainty quantification and candidate screening. We propose Isotonic Conformal Inference, a unified framework for prediction and multiple testing that separates calibration from inference and exploits the level set structure of an isotonic predictor. This structure enables the computation of localized conformal quantiles and $p$-values while avoiding repeated isotonic refitting across candidate responses. For prediction, we introduce Split Isotonic Conformal Prediction (sICP) and Transductive Isotonic Conformal Prediction (tICP), establish prediction-conditional coverage guarantees for both methods, and characterize their finite-sample and asymptotic self-calibration properties. For selection, we introduce Isotonic Conformal Selection (ICS), which provides finite-sample stratum-condition

translated_abstract: 总体偏差较小的预测器，在以其预测值为条件时仍可能表现出系统性偏差，这限制了其在下游不确定性量化和候选对象筛选中的可靠性。我们提出保序保形推断，这是一个面向预测与多重检验的统一框架，它将校准与推断相分离，并充分利用保序预测器的水平集结构。这一结构使得我们可以计算局部化的保形分位数和 p 值，同时避免在候选响应之间反复进行保序重拟合。对于预测任务，我们提出了分割式保序保形预测和直推式保序保形预测，为这两种方法建立了预测条件覆盖保证，并刻画了它们的有限样本与渐近自校准性质。对于筛选任务，我们提出了保序保形筛选（ICS），它提供有限样本分层条件下……
tldr: 提出保序保形推断统一框架，利用保序预测器的水平集结构计算局部化保形分位数与p值，在预测和多重筛选任务中提供有限样本覆盖与错误率保证，同时避免反复的保序重拟合。
en_tdlr: Isotonic Conformal Inference is a unified framework for prediction and multiple testing that exploits the level set structure of isotonic predictors to compute localized conformal quantiles and p-values, providing finite-sample coverage and error control guarantees while avoiding repeated isotonic refitting.
